items.q: When is the International Literature Festival Berlin 2026?
items.a: The main International Literature Festival Berlin programme runs from 3 to 12 September 2026. The separate Young Program runs from 6 to 16 September.

items.q: Are International Literature Festival Berlin events in English?
items.a: Some events may be in English or work without much German, but this varies by event. Check the individual official programme page for the listed language and format before booking.

items.q: Which venues are used for the festival?
items.a: The organiser lists venues including Haus der Berliner Festspiele, Humboldt Forum, Berliner Philharmonie, Dokumentationszentrum Flucht, Vertreibung, Versöhnung and Bookinista. Check the exact event page because venues vary.

items.q: How many festival events should I plan in one evening?
items.a: One fixed event is the most reliable choice unless the official schedule shows that two venues and end times connect easily. Leave a real travel buffer between tickets.

items.q: Should I make a day plan around the festival centre?
items.a: Yes. Match the day to the venue: historic centre around Humboldt Forum, Kulturforum around Berliner Philharmonie, and west Berlin around Haus der Berliner Festspiele.
